name: translation-desk
description: Local English ⇄ Spanish translation assistant on the Claude API: certified documents, legal, museum, business and technical text, with human review and approval.

scripts.install-app: npm run build:mac && codesign --force --deep --sign - "release/mac-arm64/Translation Desk.app" && rm -rf "/Applications/Translation Desk.app" && ditto "release/mac-arm64/Translation Desk.app" "/Applications/Translation Desk.app" && echo 'Installed in Applications.'

extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Translation Desk keeps your projects, glossary and translation memory in Documents › Translation Desk.
